notes: The CP criterion is broad and encompasses multiple distinct packaging requirements. The validated rule-set relation groups indicate that within each section, subsections support the same criterion, but across sections, identical requirements are specializations. No explicit cumulative or alternative connectors are present. However, the distinct nature of the requirements (importing country compliance, cleanliness/reconditioning, strength) suggests they are separate aspects that must all be satisfied. Therefore, an ALL structure is used, justified by the CP's broad wording 'packaging requirements' which implies multiple requirements may apply. The logic_basis quote is the CP criterion itself, as it is the source of the broad requirement.
